title: coccoloba vellosiana
intro: Coccoloba vellosiana, commonly known as Beach Morning Glory, is a species of flowering plant in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Coccoloba vellosiana include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The plant's bioactive constituents work together to provide relief from various health conditions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
